name: PostgreSQL
hint: Runs psql as the SSH user. The role must be able to log in without a prompt: peer authentication, or a password in ~/.pgpass on the server (mode 600).
command: psql -XAtq -F ' ' -U ${user} -d ${database} -c "SELECT 'connections', count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE backend_type = 'client backend' UNION ALL SELECT 'active', count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state = 'active' UNION ALL SELECT 'max_connections', setting::bigint FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'max_connections' UNION ALL SELECT 'commits', sum(xact_commit) FROM pg_stat_database UNION ALL SELECT 'rollbacks', sum(xact_rollback) FROM pg_stat_database UNION ALL SELECT 'size', sum(pg_database_size(datname)) FROM pg_database"
